source.verse_hash_method: SHA-256 of exact tab-separated Greek payload, retaining whitespace and variant markers.

key_decisions.before: Brothers and sisters, even if someone is caught in some wrongdoing, you who are spiritual should restore that person in a spirit of gentleness, watching yourself so that you too are not tested.
key_decisions.after: Brothers and sisters, even if someone is caught in some trespass, you who are spiritual should restore that person in a spirit of gentleness, watching yourself so that you too are not tempted.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Brothers and sisters, even if a person is caught in some transgression, you who are spiritual should restore such a one in a spirit of gentleness, watching yourself, lest you also be tempted.

key_decisions.before: Carry one another’s burdens, and in this way fulfill the law of Christ.
key_decisions.after: Carry one another's burdens, and in this way you will fulfill the law of Christ.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Bear one another’s burdens, and in this way you will fulfill the law of Christ.

key_decisions.before: For if anyone thinks they are something when they are nothing, they deceive themselves.
key_decisions.after: For if anyone thinks he is something when he is nothing, he deceives himself.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: For if anyone thinks he is something, when he is nothing, he deceives himself.

key_decisions.before: Each person should test their own work, and then they will have reason for satisfaction in themselves alone and not in comparison with someone else.
key_decisions.after: But each person should test their own work, and then the reason for boasting will concern themselves alone and not the other person,
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: But let each one examine his own work, and then he will have reason for boasting in himself alone and not in another;

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps personal responsibility alongside shared burdens.
key_decisions.before: For each person will carry their own load.
key_decisions.after: for each person will carry their own load.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: for each will bear his own load.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves material/general sharing and reciprocal roles.
key_decisions.before: The one who is taught the word should share all good things with the one who teaches.
key_decisions.after: The one being taught the word should share every good thing with the one who teaches.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Let the one who is taught the word share all good things with the one who teaches.

key_decisions.before: Do not be deceived: God is not mocked. Whatever a person sows, that is what they will reap.
key_decisions.after: Do not be deceived: God is not mocked. For whatever a person sows, that is also what the person will reap.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Do not be deceived: God is not mocked, for whatever a person sows, this he will also reap.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves agents, sources, and contrasting harvests.
key_decisions.before: The one who sows to their own flesh will reap decay from the flesh, but the one who sows to the Spirit will reap eternal life from the Spirit.
key_decisions.after: The one who sows for their own flesh will reap decay from the flesh, but the one who sows for the Spirit will reap eternal life from the Spirit.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: For the one who sows to his own flesh will from the flesh reap corruption, but the one who sows to the Spirit will from the Spirit reap eternal life.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps visual size and personal handwriting.
key_decisions.before: See what large letters I am writing to you with my own hand!
key_decisions.after: See what large letters I write to you with my own hand!
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: See with what large letters I am writing to you with my own hand.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves bodily display, coercion, and motive.
key_decisions.before: Those who want to make a good showing in the flesh are the ones trying to compel you to be circumcised, only so they will not be persecuted for Christ’s cross.
key_decisions.after: Those who want to make a good showing in the flesh are the ones compelling you to be circumcised, only so that they will not be persecuted for Christ's cross.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: It is those who want to make a good showing in the flesh who compel you to be circumcised, and only so that they may not be persecuted for the cross of Christ.

key_decisions.before: For even those who are circumcised do not themselves keep the Law, but they want you to be circumcised so they can boast in your flesh.
key_decisions.after: For even those who are circumcised do not themselves keep the law, but they want you to be circumcised so that they may boast in your flesh.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: For even those who are circumcised do not themselves keep the law, but they want you to be circumcised so that they may boast in your flesh.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves reciprocal crucifixion and sole boast.
key_decisions.before: But may I never boast except in the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ, through which the world has been crucified to me and I to the world.
key_decisions.after: But may I never boast except in the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ, through which the world has been crucified to me and I to the world.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: But far be it from me to boast except in the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ, through which the world has been crucified to me, and I to the world.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps bodily statuses and terse creation alternative.
key_decisions.before: For neither circumcision nor uncircumcision is anything; what matters is a new creation.
key_decisions.after: For neither circumcision nor uncircumcision is anything, but new creation is.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: For neither circumcision nor uncircumcision is anything, but a new creation.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves the conjunction and distinct but debated referent.
key_decisions.before: Peace and mercy upon all who walk by this rule, and upon the Israel of God.
key_decisions.after: Peace and mercy be upon all who follow this rule, and upon the Israel of God.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: And as many as walk by this rule—peace be upon them and mercy, and upon the Israel of God.

key_decisions.rationale: Retains bodily scars as marks of belonging.
key_decisions.before: From now on let no one cause me trouble, because I carry the marks of Jesus on my body.
key_decisions.after: From now on let no one cause me trouble, for I carry the marks of Jesus on my body.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: From now on let no one cause me trouble, for I bear in my body the marks of Jesus.
